Genesis medical scheme

By: Tarryn Crossman | Production

Proposal


Show:

Summary:
Case 1
Jens baby was an emergency delivery at 27 weeks, so he took his life partner to the closest private facility where the baby was admitted to NICU. When he asked genesis to put the baby on his medical aid, so its NICU stay would be covered they declined stating that Jens had "alternative options" meaning he could take her to a state facility. Jens didn't have the funds to keep his daughter in the private NICU so she was moved to Mowbray, even though they had medical aid and gap cover in place for such an incident. Genesis in the mean time refused to put his daughter onto his medical aid, stating that it was unclear whether the baby was Jens or not, as it was "Illegitimate" and various other allegations. Case went to the CMS and ruled in Jens favour. Genesis appealed and the case is on going.

Case 2
Natalie was diagnosed with Breast cancer; due to her family history she was advised to have a double mastectomy, genesis refused to pay for both breasts to be removed. They also refused to pay for any reconstruction. Even though it is a PMB. She took her case to the CMS and won her case, but Genesis appealed and she eventually just left and went to discovery who paid for her surgery and reconstruction. The case is still on going



Further information:
Case 3
Calvin’s case made headlines in 2019 after he spent over 400 days in ICU and over 300 days on a ventilator.
He was in a paragliding accident and hit a power line. He had over 60% 3rd degree burns and 40-45% 4th degree burns. Genesis base their rules on what is available at a state facility and so they are refusing to pay for his doctors as according to them he should have been listed as Palliative.
Genesis have now paid out 17 million in expenses to the hospital, mainly for the ICU but there are nearly 2 million rand in outstanding bills to the DR’s that treated him. They asking for certified copies of the reports every day of his time in ICU
The doctors are now suing Calvin and he doesn’t have the money to pay them. They also refused to pay for his rehabilitation, which is part of the PMB. He now has long term conditions developing from a lack of rehabilitation

Case studies and specialists
In Jens case, I think Jens can speak for himself. And a few small comments from his wife
Natalie - can speak for herself
Kelvin - tells his story about what happened
but I think Angela should speak about the legalities of his case.

CMS - one person should speak on all three cases and then on Genesis's policies

Genesis - one person on all three cases and answer to rules and policies at large

Then one specialist to explain the bigger picture and how genesis fits in


Extra Budget Items:
Natalie is KZN
Jens is in CT
Angela and Genesis are in CT too though
